info.name: Project Tracker API
info.description: Authentication, Overview, Projects, Tasks and milestones, People and teams, Hours, Audit and archives, Settings. Run the whole collection in order: each folder logs in the roles it needs and stores ids in collection variables.

variable.description: Local proxy. Cloud: https://<cloudfront-domain>/api/api. Direct uvicorn: http://localhost:8000

exec: pm.test('error envelope', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.error.code).to.eql('INVALID_CREDENTIALS'); });

item.name: Overview
item.description: One call per role's Overview page. Run 'Login' (emp001) first; this folder logs in mgr001 and adm001 itself.

exec: pm.test('no completed tasks listed', () => pm.expect(body.tasks.every(t => t.status !== 'completed')).to.be.true);
pm.test('3 milestones, last locked', () => pm.expect(body.focus.milestones.map(m => m.locked)).to.eql([false, false, true]));

item.name: Manager overview - project_id not a number

exec: pm.test('portfolio has both projects', () => pm.expect(body.portfolio.map(p => p.code)).to.include.members(['INF-024', 'OPS-018']));
pm.test('has INF-024 and OPS-018', () => { const codes = pm.response.json().map(p => p.code); pm.expect(codes).to.include('INF-024'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('OPS-018'); });

item.name: List projects - manager sees own only
List projects - employee sees joined, with own figures
Project detail - manager, another manager's project
Update project - manager cannot reassign manager

exec: const tasks = pm.response.json().tasks; pm.collectionVariables.set('assignedTaskId', tasks.find(t => t.display_status === 'assigned').id); pm.collectionVariables.set('blockedTaskId', tasks.find(t => t.display_status === 'blocked').id);

item.name: Milestone detail - employee sees own tasks
Create task - assignee not on project

exec: pm.test('locked until the previous one is approved', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().locked).to.be.true);

item.name: People and teams
item.description: Slice 4: admin people management, manager teams and direct reports, employee My teams. Needs the Projects folder first (managerProjectId, otherProjectId).

item.name: List people - search and role filter

exec: pm.test('has projects and blockers', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.projects).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(b.blockers).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Change role - blocked by open tasks
Direct report profile - not my report
Team options - every employee with their manager
Release direct report - blocked by open tasks
Update direct report - rate is forbidden

exec: pm.test('manager and teams', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.manager.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.teams.length).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Hours
item.description: My hours (EMPLOYEE.md sections 2 and 7): the week's ledger, logging hours after the work, corrections and removals, who reads a task's entries.

exec: pm.test('range is this week', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.range_start).to.eql(b.week.start); pm.expect(b.range_end).to.eql(b.week.end); });
pm.test('has a task to log on', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().loggable_tasks.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('range as asked', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.range_start).to.eql('2026-09-01'); pm.expect(b.range_end).to.eql('2026-09-30'); });

item.name: Employee overview - find an assigned task

exec: pm.test('only my entries', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().every(e => e.user_name === 'Sam Rivera')).to.be.true);
const d = new Date(); pm.collectionVariables.set('workDate', new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 10));
pm.test('entry as sent', () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.hours).to.eql(2); pm.expect(e.note).to.eql('Postman check'); pm.expect(e.editable).to.be.true; });

item.name: Log hours - over 24 h in a day - 400

exec: pm.test('corrected', () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.hours).to.eql(3); pm.expect(e.note).to.eql('Postman check, corrected'); });

item.name: Task entries - manager of the project

exec: pm.test('sees the new entry, read only', () => { const e = pm.response.json().find(e => String(e.id) === String(pm.collectionVariables.get('timeEntryId'))); pm.expect(e).to.exist; pm.expect(e.editable).to.be.false; });

item.name: Audit and archives
item.description: Admin only (ADMIN.md sections 6.4 and 6.5): the audit log with search, filters, dates and the before / after detail, and the archived projects and users with restore.

exec: pm.test('paginated', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.limit).to.eql(25); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(9); });
pm.test('newest first', () => { const t = pm.response.json().items.map(e => e.created_at); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });

pm.test('row shape', () => { const e = pm.response.json().items[0]; ['id', 'created_at', 'actor_id', 'actor_name', 'actor_role', 'action', 'entity_type', 'entity_id', 'summary'].forEach(k => pm.expect(e).to.have.property(k)); });

pm.test('filter values', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.actions).to.include('created'); pm.expect(b.entity_types).to.include('project'); pm.expect(b.actors.map(a => a.name)).to.include('Ada Admin'); });

item.name: List audit - page 2 of 3 per page

exec: pm.test('page echoed', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.limit).to.eql(3); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.be.at.most(3); });
pm.test('only created', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(4); b.items.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.action).to.eql('created')); });

item.name: List audit - filter by record type

exec: pm.test('only tasks', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(2); b.items.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.entity_type).to.eql('task')); });

item.name: List audit - search by record code

exec: pm.test('matches the code', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(2); b.items.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.entity_code).to.eql('INF-024')); });

pm.test('matches the actor', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(3); b.items.forEach(e => pm.expect(e.actor_name).to.eql('Morgan Lee')); pm.collectionVariables.set('auditActorId', b.items[0].actor_id); });

pm.test('only that actor', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.be.at.least(3); b.items.forEach(e => pm.expect(String(e.actor_id)).to.eql(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('auditActorId')))); });

item.name: List audit - end date before start date

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Postman archive sample",

  "department_id": "{{departmentId}}",

}

item.name: List audit - updated entry of the project

exec: pm.test('one update', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].summary).to.include('budget'); pm.collectionVariables.set('auditEntryId', b.items[0].id); });

pm.test('before and after', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.details.before.budget).to.eql(9000); pm.expect(b.details.after.budget).to.eql(9500); pm.expect(b.changes).to.deep.include({ field: 'budget', before: 9000, after: 9500 }); });
pm.test('counts add up', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(b.projects + b.users); pm.expect(b.projects).to.be.at.least(1); });

pm.test('contains the archived project', () => { const r = pm.response.json().items.find(i => i.type === 'project' && i.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('auditProjectId')); pm.expect(r).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(r.code).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('auditProjectCode')); pm.expect(r.archived_by).to.eql('Ada Admin'); pm.expect(r.archived_at).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('newest archive first', () => { const t = pm.response.json().items.map(r => r.archived_at); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });
pm.test('only projects', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(b.projects); b.items.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.type).to.eql('project')); });
pm.test('one match', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('auditProjectId')); });

item.name: List archives - restored project is gone

exec: pm.test('one restore', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].summary).to.eql('Restored project Postman archive sample'); });
pm.test('one active project, INF-024', () => pm.expect(body.projects.map(p => p.code)).to.eql(['INF-024']));
pm.test('budget remaining = budget - actual cost', () => pm.expect(body.totals.budget_remaining).to.be.closeTo(body.totals.budget - body.totals.actual_cost, 0.01));
for (let i = 1; i < starts.length; i++) pm.expect(starts[i] - starts[i - 1]).to.eql(7 * 86400000);
pm.test('series ends with the current week', () => pm.expect(body.weekly_cost[4].week_start).to.eql(body.week.start));
pm.test('VALIDATION_ERROR on email', () => { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('VALIDATION_ERROR'); pm.expect(e.fields).to.have.property('email'); });

item.name: Update my profile - restore seed name

exec: pm.test('seeded departments with counts', () => { const inf = items.find(d => d.prefix === 'INF'); pm.expect(inf.name).to.eql('Infrastructure'); pm.expect(inf.people).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(items.map(d => d.prefix)).to.include('OPS'); });
pm.test('every row has its fields', () => items.forEach(d => pm.expect(d).to.include.all.keys('id', 'name', 'prefix', 'next_project_seq', 'people', 'active_projects')));
// A fresh name and a P?? prefix derived from the clock, so reruns do not collide with earlier runs or the seed (INF, OPS).

pm.test('prefix upper-cased, counts at zero', () => { pm.expect(body.prefix).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('newDepartmentPrefix').toUpperCase()); pm.expect(body.people).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.active_projects).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.next_project_seq).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Create department - name and prefix taken

exec: pm.test('VALIDATION_ERROR on name', () => { const e = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(e.code).to.eql('VALIDATION_ERROR'); pm.expect(e.fields).to.have.property('name'); });

pm.test('renamed, prefix kept', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.name).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('newDepartmentName') + ' renamed'); pm.expect(body.prefix).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('newDepartmentPrefix').toUpperCase()); });
